answer: Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 48% independent neighbours on the funding graph. Because the lagoon calculation reruns each epoch, the crystal weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the falcon settlement publishes the resulting shares. A tight ring of 22 clones thus holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
